subject: COMMIT statement
notes: kb/Work PB3338 (wave 1154) and PB3540 (wave 1157): the APPLY COMMIT clause, COMMIT and ROLLBACK are provided for RELATIVE and INDEXED files, whose keyed store engine keeps the transaction (kb/Work PB3337); a SEQUENTIAL or LINE SEQUENTIAL file named in the clause is under commit control too, its transaction journal being kb/Work PB3340 (COBOL1709, which refused it, is retired) (Annex A.4.3 stays PARTIAL, docs/CONFORMANCE.md 5; this rule's obligations are met for every file the clause admits). GR2: a COMMIT with an active clause, under the control of a recursive runtime element or an active SORT or MERGE procedure, raises EC-FLOW-COMMIT (TransactionControl.FlowForbidden) and with checking off changes nothing; the static reach, the statement written in a recursive element or in the procedure itself, is SR1/SR2's COBOL1690. A recursive runtime element (8.6.6: a RECURSIVE program, a function, a method) is a frame the module stack marks recursive: the emitted method body (OoEmitter.EmitMethod) pushes it for a method, ProgramTable.CallProgram and ActivateMain for a program or function, and FlowForbidden asks ModuleStack.AnyRecursive, so a COMMIT in a program a method CALLs (an object or a factory method alike) raises the condition (pb3540_commit_rollback_under_method with checking on, pb3540_commit_under_factory_method_unchecked with it off, where the COMMIT commits nothing). Negative control: a program with no RECURSIVE attribute under no recursive element commits (TransactionControlTests.Commit_under_programs_that_are_not_recursive_runs). retired-witness: conformance-test:DeclinedFacilityTests.CommitAndRollback_DrawTheNamedNonSupportWarning_OncePerSite (COBOL1579 is retired: COMMIT and ROLLBACK are no longer accept-inert (kb/Work PB3338), and the pb259/pb261 goldens declare no APPLY COMMIT clause, so they witness GR1, not this rule) retired-witness: conformance:wiseowl/cases/14.9.7-COMMIT/pb259_commit_rollback_recursive (COBOL1579 is retired: COMMIT and ROLLBACK are no longer accept-inert (kb/Work PB3338), and the pb259/pb261 goldens declare no APPLY COMMIT clause, so they witness GR1, not this rule) retired-witness: conformance:wiseowl/cases/14.9.7-COMMIT/pb259_commit_rollback_under_sort (COBOL1579 is retired: COMMIT and ROLLBACK are no longer accept-inert (kb/Work PB3338), and the pb259/pb261 goldens declare no APPLY COMMIT clause, so they witness GR1, not this rule) retired-witness: src/Cobol.Net.Runtime/Control/ProgramTable.cs#AnyRecursiveActive (kb/Work PB3540: the recursion question is the run unit's module stack's (ModuleStack.AnyRecursive), because a method is a frame there and no ProgramTable node; the table's own query, which could not see a method, is deleted)
